text:
The Supreme Court's decision in Roe v. Wade is highly controversial because the justices in the majority ruled without reviewing any medical testimony, expert briefs, or scientific literature on pregnancy and fetal development, relying purely on legal argument. This approach led to a ruling that established federal protections for abortion rights which many opponents believe infringes upon state interests and moral convictions regarding when life begins. Consequently, the decision has sparked decades of intense political debate over bodily autonomy versus religious beliefs without grounding in medical evidence.

CONFIDENCE: 95
